content.description: Iteration 1 from the Saval base: raise seeker shares to the observed wrong-lane shares (M8), cut swarm red-running p0 to 0.2 (M3), turn on early start p=0.13 (M2), and activate queue space seeking at q=15 m (M9, M10).

driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023, Table 11 (Driver parameter values for Hanoi, column Car, GA-calibrated on Tay Son): max acceleration a = 1.2 m/s2 -> accel, max deceleration b = 4.8 m/s2 -> decel, time headway T = 2.5 s -> tau, safety distance s0 = 1.1 m -> minGap (IDM -> Krauss, literature_transferred). Sec 4: cars always stop at red, so no red-running rule and the jm* attributes stay at the SUMO defaults (never drive at red). One archetype: the paper has one car driver type. Iteration 1: share 0.93 so that, with car_seeker 0.07, the non-seeking car share matches the observed wrong-lane share of cars M8/car = 0.068.

F2 structure (Viktor 2026-10-27, F2-behaviours fix round 1): car violators (custom2, PLAN 0) drawn from the car distribution, the only cars queue_space_seeking may act on. Params copied from car_saval (Saval et al. 2023 Table 11, literature_transferred), so with every p = 0 they drive exactly like car_saval. Share 0.1 is assumed (no source for the share of space-seeking drivers): small, so the B1 car population stays essentially the Saval one; P1/B2 tune it. Iteration 1: share 0.07 targets M8/car (0.068 wrong-lane share of turning cars) and M9a/M9b; larger would overshoot the car share while smaller leaves the car space-seeking events absent.

Saval et al. 2023, Table 11 (column Motorcycle): a = 1.1 m/s2 -> accel, b = 4.6 m/s2 -> decel, T = 0.8 s -> tau, s0 = 1.9 m -> minGap (IDM -> Krauss, literature_transferred). minGapLat: Sec 4 sizes a motorcycle 'lane' as 0.8 m = 0.7 m width + 0.1 m safe spacing, i.e. ~0.1 m lateral gap; 0.1 m is below the lower bound 0.3 m of the space (ruling R15), so the bound 0.3 m is used (transferred and clipped). One archetype: the paper has one motorcycle driver type. Iteration 1: share 0.75 (complement of moto_seeker 0.25) so the non-violating motorcycle share matches M8/moto = 0.249.

F2 structure (Viktor 2026-10-27, F2-behaviours fix round 1): motorcycle violators (custom1, PLAN 0) drawn from the moto distribution, the only riders that may use the custom1-only sidewalk or the right-lane / wrong-lane spaces of queue_space_seeking. Params copied from moto_saval (Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 / Sec 4, literature_transferred), and the same red-running / early-start rules, so with every p = 0 they ride exactly like moto_saval. Share 0.1 is assumed (no source): small, so B1's motorcycle population stays essentially the Saval one; P1/B2 tune it. Iteration 1: share 0.25 targets M8/moto (0.249 wrong-lane share of turning motorcycles) and M10a (0.56 sidewalk riders per cycle), which a 0.1 share cannot reach.

Illegal left-turning motorcycles (vTypeDistribution moto_violator). The car-following and lateral values are the motorcycle values of Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 / Sec 4, as for moto_saval: they are the same riders. jmTimegapMinor = 1.0 s is the SUMO default and is assumed (the paper has no illegal left turn and no gap acceptance); it is in the structure because it is the early-leaving lever of the box waiters (ruling R15) that P1/B2 tune.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023, Sec 4 'Description of the model and parameters used': from the Tay Son footage 'the probability of stopping for motorcycles (in the front row) is only 0.5'; 'a motorcycle arriving at a red light will have only a 50% chance to stop'. Transferred as a constant run-the-red probability p0 = p_max = 0.5 for a motorcycle reaching the stop line during red, k = 0 (the paper has no swarm effect). dt = 10 s is assumed and has no effect while k = 0. Iteration 1: p0 = p_max = 0.2 (was 0.5, the front-row-only Saval value) to move the all-motorcycle red-running share toward M3/share/moto = 0.098 and M3/per_cycle = 3.9; only the front row decides at the line, so 0.2 lies between 0.5 and the observed 0.098; k stays 0.

Not in Saval et al. 2023 (assumed): the paper models no early start, so the rule is off (p = 0). It is part of the fixed structure so that P1/B2 can tune the M2 early-start share; t_before_green and v_max are assumed mid-range values without effect while p = 0. Iteration 1: p = 0.13 targets M2/early/moto = 0.130 (early-start share in last 10 s of red); t_before_green 8 s lies in the 4-10 s lead-time target.

Not in Saval et al. 2023 (assumed): the paper has no space seeking (wrong lane, right-turn-lane blocking, sidewalk), so every p = 0 and the green check is off (t_g_s = 0), like early_start p = 0. It is part of the fixed structure (Viktor 2026-10-27) so that P1/B2 can tune behaviours 5-7. q = 30 m, v_creep = 3 m/s and merge_zone_m = 15 m (the Phase 3A setting) are assumed mid-range values without effect while every p = 0. Iteration 1: q = 15 m matches the observed queue at choice (M9c 15.7 m, M10b 15.3 m); p_sidewalk 0.1 and p_right_lane 0.05 target M10a / M9a (about 0.56 vehicles per cycle each) given a 0.25 moto_seeker share; p_wrong_lane 0.2 reflects 0.19-0.23 observed in q0-40 m (inapplicable on the proxy net, so it is redistributed); sum 0.35 <= 1.

reasoning: Starting from the Saval-transferred base, I changed only values that the observation targets point to. Swarm p0/p_max 0.5 -> 0.2 because the observed moto red-running share is 0.098 (M3), far below the front-row 0.5. Early start p 0 -> 0.13 and t_before_green 8 s match M2/early/moto = 0.130. Queue space seeking was switched on (q 15 m from M9c/M10b, p_wrong_lane 0.2, p_right_lane 0.05, p_sidewalk 0.1 from the M8/M9/M10 targets) and the seeker shares raised to 0.25 (moto) and 0.07 (car) to match M8 wrong-lane shares. Car-following and lateral params were left unchanged because no feedback yet shows them off.
